payload.posture: Read 2 Maccabees 12:31–32 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states after thanking the people of Scythopolis, Judas’s company travels to Jerusalem because the Feast of Weeks is near and resumes its campaign after Pentecost. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
